change: Zip4j #541, reopen names and payloads after file and directory renames
deployment: Both complete pinned source builds with no runtime dependencies.
assumptions: Fresh relative archive per JVM, unique ASCII names, fixed timestamps and distinct two-byte payloads. Both renames use the public API, and fresh JDK readers compare every name, directory flag and byte.

questions.observer: Read names and bytes through the JDK after each of two successive file renames.
questions.basis: An exact file key has one destination. The historical prefix rule also transforms the name of its neighbor. The sequence preserves each entry's original two-byte payload.

questions.observer: Check the entire JDK enumeration twice after a directory rename and an isolated exact file rename.
questions.basis: A trailing slash separates the directory from catalog. Renaming the longest file changes only its own name. Payloads and the directory flag persist.
